results.title: Home - Missouri SBDC at Missouri State University
results.content: # Your Business. The Missouri Small Business Development Center (SBDC) at Missouri State University is a leading resource for growing and developing businesses, serving 15 counties in southwest Missouri. With offices located in Springfield, Forsyth and West Plains, the Missouri SBDC at Missouri State University offers one-on-one consulting and training to business owners and leaders. As part of the efactory’s business support program, the Missouri State SBDC helps accelerate Missouri’s economy by offering business consulting, training and workforce development solutions. The Missouri SBDC is part of a larger state and nationwide network of business resource programs, funded in part through the University of Missouri Office of Extenstion and the U.S. Small Business Administration.
